raw:
Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the smaller astronaut in the 2006-01-21 APOD as Alan Bean (placing him in NASA Astronaut Group 3). The smaller astronaut is actually Ed White (Group 2). This incorrect identification led to selecting the wrong astronaut group and thus the wrong least-time calculation. Additionally, later they inconsistently concluded Schweickart had the least time in Group 3 despite listing Anders with fewer hours, but the first, decisive error occurred at Step 4.
